claims: Spring starts on March 20 or 21 in the Northern Hemisphere.
Spring starts on September 22 or 23 in the Southern Hemisphere.
Astronomical spring months in the Northern Hemisphere are March, April, May, and June.
The vernal equinox brings roughly 12 hours of day and night.
After the vernal equinox, daylight increases until the summer solstice.
Astronomical Spring begins on the vernal equinox around March 20-21.
Meteorological Spring is often defined by meteorologists as starting March 1 and ending May 31 for statistical consistency
